title: The Earthquake
text:
One morning, a strong earthquake shook a city in the south of the country. Many people were at home when the ground began to move. Some buildings fell down, and people ran outside into the streets.

Rescue teams arrived quickly to look for people under the buildings. They worked for three days. Thanks to their hard work, many people were saved.

questions.text: What did people do when the ground began to move?
options: They ran outside into the streets

questions.text: How long did the rescue teams work?
Why did the rescue teams work so hard?
options: They wanted to save as many people as possible
They did not know about the earthquake
They were looking for a new home

questions.text: How did the people in the city probably feel after the earthquake?
options: They were frightened and needed help
They did not want to leave their homes
They were happy about the damage

vocabulary.definition: a sudden shaking of the ground
large structures with walls and a roof, such as houses or offices
the act of saving people from danger

paragraph_translations: Одного ранку сильний землетрус струсонув місто на півдні країни. Багато людей були вдома, коли земля почала рухатися. Деякі будівлі впали, і люди вибігли на вулицю.
Рятувальні команди швидко прибули, щоб шукати людей під будівлями. Вони працювали три дні. Завдяки їхній напруженій праці багатьох людей врятували.
